[[Forgerunner]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Tarnok Forgerunner]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Fire damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while in a [[Stance]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Feathered Longbow]].
